# v2 round-trip corpus

Real composite documents that `tests/v2/test_roundtrip_corpus.py` reads into the v2 model, prints as `.pbl` v2
text (the snapshots in `../snapshots/`, committed and reviewed by hand) and writes back as an equivalent document.
`PBLANG_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 pytest tests/v2` regenerates the snapshots. This directory is excluded from prettier
(`.prettierignore`) so the fixtures stay verbatim.

| File                                        | Provenance                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `reversible-dimerization.composite.yaml`    | copied verbatim from `viva-smoldyn/viva_smoldyn/composites/` (vivarium-collective/viva-smoldyn, 2026-10)                                               |
| `hybrid_two_way_exchange.json`              | generated by `make_hybrid_fixture.py` in the viva-pde-particle environment (`two_way_exchange()` + `attach_recorder`), branch `static-interfaces`; `out_dir` rewritten to a relative path |
| `template_sites.json`                       | the expected document of `test_open_values_compile_to_template_sites` in `tests/compiler/generator/test_dsl_compiler.py`                              |

The other corpus entries are built at test time by the Python tests: the growth-division nested composite from
`process_bigraph.processes.growth_division`, the spatio-flux grids from the v1 expected templates in
`tests/compiler/generator/spatio_flux/`, and the saved form of the toy add-floats composite. `v1/*.json` holds
the same documents (plus the other v1 expected templates) dumped by `make_v1_fixtures.py` for the TypeScript
tests (`dsl/test/v2/roundtrip.test.ts`); regenerate them with `poetry run python
tests/fixtures/data/v2/corpus/make_v1_fixtures.py` when the templates change. Tuples are tagged as
`{"__tuple__": true, "data": [...]}`.

`../interfaces/` holds the headers and manifest that `python -m process_bigraph_lang.v2 describe` generated from
viva-pde-particle (branch `static-interfaces`, where every component's ports are fixed by its class) in that
package's own environment.
